A '''[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' was distinguished by their tall, fleshy necks, with multiple overlapping chins, downturned [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]], exposed [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]], enormous [[Ear/Legends|ears]], [[Bone/Legends|spines]] lining their brow, and long [[Hair/Legends|hair]] extending from the sides and back of their head.<ref name="AOTC" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="EP2Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> [[Unidentified fleshy Jedi Master/Legends|a member]] of this species had been a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], well known enough to have multiple busts of them displayed around the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="AOTC" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HairyBust-AOTC.png|thumb|right|200px|This species' original maquette.]]
The species first appeared as a bust in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars:'' Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> This design was originally created as a maquette bust by [[John Knoll]] and team,<ref name="FPtP">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=From Puppets to Pixels: Digital Characters in Episode II}}</ref> including [[Robert E. Barnes]],<ref name="Barnes">{{WebCite|url=http://www.robertebarnesdesign.com/portfolio.html|text=Robert E Barnes Design|work=[http://www.robertebarnesdesign.com Robert E Barnes Design]|archivedate=20251013210905}}</ref> to serve as a potential design for the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], presented alongside twenty-three other species sculptures for [[George Lucas]] to choose from. Though Lucas would eventually request to combine two of the other head sculpts to better accommodate his vision,<ref name="FPtP" /> a handful of the unselected species maquettes would be recycled, with some like this one turned into busts to fill the Jedi Archives.<ref name="AOTC" />
